items: Accounting: the three statements and how they link; IFRS basics.
Valuation: DCF, WACC, trading comparables, precedent transactions. For the ТеДо valuation team, also the Russian appraisal rules: 135-ФЗ «Об оценочной деятельности» and ФСО I–VI.
Excel modeling speed and clean PowerPoint slides.
Numerical and verbal reasoning tests (B1, Gazprombank, Sber).

tracks.name: Track B: risk and model validation

whatTheyTest.title: What they test
items: Credit-risk parameters: probability of default (PD), loss given default (LGD), exposure at default (EAD). Expected loss is their product: EL = PD × LGD × EAD.
Validation metrics: discriminatory power (Gini = 2 × AUC − 1), calibration tests, population stability index (PSI).
Regulation: IFRS 9 expected credit loss and its three stages; the Russian internal-ratings rules, now Положение Банка России 845-П, which replaced 483-П in February 2025.
Tools: statistics, logistic regression, Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels), SQL, Excel.

tracks.name: Track C: data analytics and data science in banks

whatTheyTest.title: What they test
items: SQL: JOINs, GROUP BY, subqueries; window functions for stronger candidates.
Python with pandas, plus basic statistics.
For analytics roles: A/B tests, product metrics, dashboards.
For DS roles: gradient boosting (CatBoost), feature engineering, model metrics.
T-Bank's analyst selection is a 90–120 minute task, then an HR video interview and a technical interview.

tracks.name: Track D: quant and AI research

whatTheyTest.title: What you need on top of Tracks B and C
items: Math: linear algebra, calculus, probability, and some stochastic processes for pricing.
Finance: derivatives pricing (Black–Scholes), risk metrics (VaR, expected shortfall), fixed income.
Deep learning: PyTorch, neural networks, transformers; for the LLM track, fine-tuning (SFT, LoRA) and RL basics.
Sber Risk Research posting, Risk Quant: pricing models and risk metrics, financial markets, transformers, diffusion models, VAE, LLM, RL.
Sber Risk Research posting, Data Scientist: ML for lending: uplift modeling, time series, AI agents, transformer-based models.
Sber Risk Research posting, LLM Researcher: AI agents, multi-agent systems, SFT, LoRA, GRPO, RL, reasoning.
